noteContent.title: RBI Monetary Policy Feb 2026 — Repo Rate Held at 5.25%, MSME Loan Limit Doubled
noteContent.summary: RBI keeps Repo Rate unchanged at 5.25%, doubles collateral-free MSME loan limit to ₹20 lakh, and sets digital-fraud compensation cap at ₹25,000.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Monetary Policy Feb 2026 — Repo Rate Held at 5.25%, MSME Loan Limit Doubled. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI MPC kept the **Repo Rate unchanged at 5.25%** with a neutral stance. Key policy decisions focused on structural MSME and consumer protection reforms.

**Policy Rates**: Repo 5.25%, SDF (standing deposit facility without collateral) 5.00%, MSF (marginal standing facility for emergency borrowing) & Bank Rate 5.50%, Reverse Repo 3.35%, CRR 3%, SLR 18%.
**MSME Limit Doubled**: Collateral-free MSME loan limit doubled to **₹20 lakh** (from ₹10 lakh) effective 1 April 2026.
**Digital-Fraud Compensation**: Victim and bank each bear 15% of loss; RBI covers the remaining 70%, capped at **₹25,000/case** via DEA Fund.
**Growth & Inflation**: FY26 GDP 7.4%; FY26 CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) inflation 2.1%.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on Repo Rate figure (5.25%), MPC stance ('Neutral'), MSME collateral-free threshold, and inflation forecast.

noteContent.summary: FM Nirmala Sitharaman presented Union Budget 2026-27 with fiscal deficit target of 4.3% of GDP, Capex at ₹12.2 lakh crore, and the New Income Tax Act 2025.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Union Budget 2026-27 — Sitharaman's First Budget from Kartavya Bhawan. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Presented by FM Nirmala Sitharaman on 1 Feb 2026, this was the **1st Budget prepared in the new Kartavya Bhawan building**, built around 3 'Kartavyas': growth, citizen aspirations, and inclusive development.
**Fiscal Deficit BE 2026-27**: 4.3% of GDP (down from 4.4% in RE 2025-26); Debt-to-GDP down to 55.6% (from 56.1%).
**Capex Push**: Up 9% to a record **₹12.2 lakh crore (4.4% of GDP)**; total expenditure ₹53.5 lakh Cr, net tax receipts ₹28.7 lakh Cr.
**New Income Tax Act, 2025**: Effective 1 Apr 2026—sections simplified from 819 to 536.
**TCS Cuts**: Overseas tour packages cut to 2% (from 5%/20%); LRS education/medical cut to 2% (from 5%).
**STT Hiked**: Futures raised to 0.05%, Options to 0.15%; corporate buyback tax set at 22% (30% non-corporate).
**New Sectoral Schemes**: Biopharma SHAKTI (₹10,000 Cr), SME Growth Fund (₹10,000 Cr), 7 High-Speed Rail corridors, 20 new National Waterways, Bharat-VISTAAR AI agri-tool.
Mnemonic '4.3 - 4.4 - 55.6' — Fiscal deficit 4.4% -> 4.3%, Debt-to-GDP 56.1% -> 55.6%.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 India's Wetlands Cross 98 Ramsar Sites. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: On 31 January 2026, two new wetland sites were designated as Ramsar sites ahead of World Wetlands Day (2 Feb), taking India's total count to **98 Ramsar sites** (a 276% growth from 26 in 2014).
**New Sites**: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah, UP) and Chhari-Dhand (Kutch, Gujarat).
**Ramsar Convention**: Adopted 1971 in Ramsar, Iran; India ratified in 1982.
**World's First Ramsar Site**: Cobourg Peninsula, Australia (1974).
The exact current count of Ramsar sites in India is 98.
